lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p25 - Complete the number line.

details: Complete the number line develops reverse sequencing skills by tens. Students identify the missing numbers in the countdown sequence (50, 30) to complete the line from 70 down to 10.
Look for correct writing of '50' between 60 and 40, and '30' between 40 and 20.

Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
